response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(c.scancount) AS total_scans, SUM(c.gbsize) * 1.0 / SUM(c.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans c JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM g) SELECT g.status, g.total_scans, g.rate, g.rate - a.avg_rate AS rate_minus_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.rate > a.avg_rate

assumptions.assumption: Scans whose site has a NULL healtheval are still joined and form their own NULL-status group, which counts as one status in the average of rates.
A status whose summed spanmin is zero or NULL has a NULL rate; it is ignored in the average and excluded from the output.
